title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (August, 2026)
summary: The August 2026 cumulative updates for Business Central are out: 28.4 (BC28 CU04) for 2026 release wave 1 on cloud and on-premises, 27.10 for 2025 wave 2 and 26.16 for 2025 wave 1. The post gives the platform and application build numbers, marks BC13 to BC25 as end of life, and includes lifecycle tables for releases from 2018 through 2026.
key_points: Version 28.4 (BC28 CU04) released for 2026 Release Wave 1 with Platform 28.0.53289.0 and Application 28.4.53241.53312 in cloud
On-premises update 28.4 available with Platform 28.0.53152 and Application 28.4.53241
Multiple cumulative updates released: BC27 CU10 and BC26 CU16 for earlier waves
2026 Release Wave 1 support runs from April 1, 2026 to October 13, 2027
Multiple older versions (BC25 through BC13) marked as end of life with defined retirement dates
